title: Temporal-Difference Calibration of Black-Box Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2610.35311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a derivative-free temporal-difference (TD) framework for calibrating black-box simulators using one-step transitions from a target system and noisy simulator-generated continuation values. The calibration parameter is defined through Bellman orthogonality, recovering the physical parameter under correct simulator specification and yielding a near-optimal $L_2$ approximation of the policy value under misspecification. We propose three TD algorithms based on random-direction finite differences, distinguished by their query costs and reuse of noisy simulator evaluations. We establish almost-sure convergence, last-iterate mean-square error bounds, and central limit theorems for Polyak-Ruppert averages across four query-noise regimes. translated_title: 黑箱模拟器的时序差分校准
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个无导数的时序差分（TD）框架，用于利用来自目标系统的一步转移和模拟器生成的含噪延续值来校准黑箱模拟器。校准参数通过Bellman正交性来定义，当模拟器设定正确时能够恢复真实的物理参数，当设定存在偏差时则给出策略值的近最优L2逼近。我们提出了三种基于随机方向有限差分的TD算法，它们在查询成本和含噪模拟器评估结果的复用方式上各有不同。我们在四种查询噪声情形下建立了算法的几乎必然收敛性、最后一步迭代的均方误差界以及Polyak-Ruppert平均的中心极限定理。我们的分析揭示了一种依赖于模拟器设定的偏差现象：对于其中两种算法，在设定正确的条件下，TD估计方程的有限差分偏差在校准目标处消失。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于Bellman正交性的无导数时序差分校准框架，通过三种随机方向有限差分算法校准黑箱模拟器，并建立了涵盖收敛性、均方误差界和中心极限定理的完整理论保证，同时揭示了依赖于模拟器设定正确性的有限差分偏差现象。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a derivative-free temporal-difference calibration framework based on Bellman orthogonality for black-box simulators, proposing three random-direction finite-difference algorithms with comprehensive theoretical guarantees including almost-sure convergence, mean-square error bounds, and central limit theorems, while revealing a specification-dependent finite-difference bias phenomenon.
